query: UPDATE idempotency SET execution_status='queued',held=true,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id=$1 AND route=$2 AND execution_status IN ('sending','delivered') AND team_copy_seq IS NULL AND updated_at > COALESCE($3,'-infinity'::timestamptz) AND updated_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-make_interval(secs=>$4) RETURNING ordinal
